title.en: An Act Providing for An Annual Grant of One Million Pesos From the National Government to the City of Manila.

text.en:
The sum of one million pesos is appropriated out of any funds in the Philippine Treasury, not
otherwise appropriated, to be expended at the discretion of the Secretary of Public Works and
Communications for the construction of public improvements in the City of Manila.

An equal amount shall be included yearly in the General Appropriation Act, beginning with the
year nine-1 teen hundred and thirty-nine, for the purpose herein provided and under identical conditions.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, December 9, 1937.
